verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits low, leaving a big dead band at the top. The CTA has shrunk to unreadably small text and floats bottom-right, off the headline's centre axis, so it looks stranded and accidental. B: the headline is better sized and fills the banner, but the CTA is just as tiny and is jammed against the headline's descenders and the bottom edge, roughly aligned left under a centred headline. Both lose the CTA hierarchy; B is slightly less bad because the headline carries the format.
